user.title: Set up Sunsynk Optimizer
user.description: Configure the Sunsynk IDs and related entities/services.

data.plant_id: Plant ID (used for Sunsynk API writes)
data.inverter_serial: Inverter serial (used for SolarSynkV3 sensor entity IDs)
data.cost_aware_export_shadow_mode: Cost-aware export threshold — observe only (recommended until reviewed)
data.import_feedback_live: Adjust the overnight target from day-rate import (off = observe only)
data.peak_export_live: Sell the surplus above the evening reserve at the peak rate (off = observe only)
data.gentle_charge_live: Charge gently across 02:00-05:00 at the lowest grid charge current that reaches the target (off = observe only)
data.full_window_live: Hold the target to 05:00 every night so the grid runs the house after the charge (off = observe only)
data.measured_charge_rate_live: Size the 02:00 window from the charge rate measured on the meters (off = observe only)
data.evening_load_live: Size the evening reserve from the learned 16:00-22:00 load (off = observe only)
data.load_profile_live: Size the evening reserve and peak cover from the learned half-hourly load profile (off = observe only)
data.trim_defer_live: Trim only the solar that would overflow and sell the rest at the peak rate (needs peak export live; off = observe only)
data.full_charge_skip_live: Skip the weekly full-charge night when the battery reached 99% in the last 7 days (off = observe only)
data.peak_cover_live: Top up the battery at the day rate before 16:00 if it would not last the peak window (off = observe only)
data.baseload_alert: Notify at 05:00 when overnight house load is well above normal (something left on?)
data.battery_cost_gbp: Battery purchase cost in £ (optional; with lifetime kWh, adds a wear cost to export/arbitrage decisions)
data.battery_lifetime_kwh: Battery rated lifetime throughput in kWh (optional; cost ÷ this = wear p/kWh)
data.upgrade_price_per_kwh: Price of extra battery in £ per kWh (optional; adds payback to the monthly upgrade report)
data.pv_kwp: Installed solar panel size in kWp (optional; enables the extra-PV scenario in the upgrade report)
data.pv_upgrade_price_per_kwp: Price of extra solar panels in £ per kWp (optional; payback for the PV scenario)
data.spare_solar_notify_kwh: Morning notification when spare midday solar is at least this many kWh (optional; blank = off)
data.flex_event_entity: Flexibility export event entity (optional calendar or on/off entity; on = an event that pays for export; logged only)
data.flex_price_pence: Flexibility event payment in p/kWh exported (optional; needed to value the events)
data.gas_unit_pence: Gas unit price in p/kWh (optional; enables the heat-pump scenario in the monthly upgrade report)
data.gas_standing_pence: Gas standing charge in p/day (optional; removed from the gas cost before converting to kWh)
data.heat_pump_price_gbp: Installed heat pump price in £ after grants (optional; adds payback to the heat-pump scenario)
data.battery_voltage: Battery nominal voltage (V, for charge current maths)
data.auto_away_min_hours: Auto away: hours everyone must be away
data.export_limit_w: Inverter export limit (W; 0 = clipped-solar detection off)
data.solar_start_offset_hours: Hours after sunrise until solar covers load
data.bill_start_day: Bill usage period start day (1 = calendar month; the first date in the bill's "We have charged you" lines)
data.octopus_import_rates_entity: Octopus import rates entity (optional; current rate sensor or day rates event)
data.octopus_export_rates_entity: Octopus export rates entity (optional; current rate sensor or day rates event)
data.octopus_import_consumption_sensor: Octopus import 'previous accumulative consumption' sensor (optional; enables the monthly tariff comparison)
data.octopus_export_consumption_sensor: Octopus export 'previous accumulative consumption' sensor (optional; enables the monthly tariff comparison)
data.tariff_rate_overrides: Tariff comparison overrides (optional JSON; unit rates p/kWh ex-VAT, standing p/day, e.g. {"go": {"cheap": 8.5, "standing": 54.62}, "vat_percent": 0, "agile_region": "C"})
data.data_report_target: Daily data report notify target (optional, developer)
data.notify_min_level: Send at once: reports and up / information and up / action needed only (the rest is held)
data.notify_quiet_start: Quiet hours start (HH:MM, optional; only action-needed messages are sent inside them)
data.morning_brief_time: Morning brief time (HH:MM, optional; one message with the plan, forecast and anything held)
data.enable_ai_weekly_insight: Enable AI Task weekly insight (optional, off by default)

error.cannot_connect: Could not log in to Sunsynk.
error.battery_soc_not_found: Battery SOC sensor was not found for this inverter serial.
error.grid_pac_not_found: Grid power (grid_pac) sensor was not found for this inverter serial.
error.invalid_service: Service must be in domain.service format.

flux.title: Flux windows
flux.description: Configure the baseline Flux import/export windows.

error.cannot_connect: Could not log in to Sunsynk.
error.battery_soc_not_found: Battery SOC sensor was not found for this inverter serial.
error.grid_pac_not_found: Grid power (grid_pac) sensor was not found for this inverter serial.
error.invalid_service: Service must be in domain.service format.
error.quiet_pair: Set both the quiet hours start and end, or neither.
error.invalid_time: Enter a 24-hour time as HH:MM, for example 16:00.
error.same_time: Start and end cannot be the same time.

api_unreliable.title: Sunsynk Optimizer: Sunsynk cloud unreliable
api_unreliable.description: More than {rate}% of Sunsynk cloud calls failed on each of the last {days} days. Plans and pushes may be retried or missed; see the Cloud API success rate sensor and the 22:00 api_health line.

data_missing.title: Sunsynk Optimizer: missing daily records
data_missing.description: {count} daily records are missing from the last 14 days: {items}. Learned corrections skip these days. This clears itself once the gaps age out or are filled.

data_duplicate.title: Sunsynk Optimizer: duplicate daily records
data_duplicate.description: {count} per-day records were logged twice: {items}. Check the data folder for a restart that crossed a scheduled capture.

bill_coverage_low.title: Sunsynk Optimizer: too few logged days to check the bill
bill_coverage_low.description: Only {logged} of {total} days were logged for the bill period {period}, so the bill check is a projection at best. This clears when a later bill has enough logged days.

data_contradiction.title: Sunsynk Optimizer: inconsistent daily figures
data_contradiction.description: {count} days have figures that contradict each other: {items}. The learned corrections may be using a bad input.

config_bad_time.title: Sunsynk Optimizer: a tariff or Flux time is not HH:MM
config_bad_time.description: These saved times are not in 24-hour HH:MM form: {items}. Prices and the evening export check cannot run until they are fixed. Open Configure, correct the time and save.

set_tonight_target.name: Set tonight's target
set_tonight_target.description: Override the next overnight charge target SOC (applies to the next 01:55 plan; learning ignores that night).

skip_tonight.name: Skip tonight's charge
skip_tonight.description: Hold the battery where it is for the next overnight plan (no grid charge).

schedule_free_event.name: Schedule a free event
schedule_free_event.description: Plan a free electricity event: sell before, refill during.

cancel_free_event.name: Cancel the free event
cancel_free_event.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-progress free event.

get_plan.name: Get the plan
get_plan.description: Dry-run tonight's plan and return it. Pushes, logs and stores nothing.

export_data.name: Export data to CSV
export_data.description: Write the logged history as CSV files (one per record type plus a daily summary) to a new folder under the config directory, and return the paths. Read-only; identifiers are masked.

start.name: From date
start.description: First day to export. Defaults to 90 days ago.

end.name: To date
end.description: Last day to export. Defaults to today.

types.name: Record types
types.description: Only these record types (for example day_actuals). Blank exports all and adds the daily summary.

probe_inverter_events.name: Probe inverter events
probe_inverter_events.description: Read-only check of which Sunsynk cloud alarm/event routes respond, and what they return.
